"""Anonymous candidate readback; preserve bytes and a machine-readable receipt."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = 'vLLM-HUST/vllm-ascend-pyramidkv-hust'
TAG = 'v0.4.0rc2.dev0'
OUT = ROOT / 'public-download'
EXPECTED = ROOT / 'release-assets'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
client = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
request = urllib.request.Request(
    f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/{TAG}',
    headers={'User-Agent': 'PyramidKV-anonymous-candidate-verifier', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'},
)
with client.open(request, timeout=30) as response:
    release = json.load(response)
assert release['draft'] is False and release['prerelease'] is True
names = {p.name for p in EXPECTED.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
assert names == {a['name'] for a in release['assets']}
checks = {}
for asset in release['assets']:
    name = asset['name']
    assert Path(name).name == name
    req = urllib.request.Request(asset['browser_download_url'], headers={'User-Agent': 'PyramidKV-anonymous-candidate-verifier'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
        data = response.read()
    assert data == (EXPECTED/name).read_bytes(), name
    assert len(data) == asset['size'], name
    (OUT/name).write_bytes(data)
    checks[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data), 'url': asset['browser_download_url']}
for line in (OUT/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
    sha, name = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert name in checks and checks[name]['sha256'] == sha
provenance = json.loads((OUT/'release-provenance.json').read_text())
for name, row in provenance['artifacts'].items():
    assert checks[name]['sha256'] == row['sha256'] and checks[name]['bytes'] == row['bytes']
wheel = next(OUT.glob('*.whl'))
sdist = next(OUT.glob('*.tar.gz'))
extract = OUT/'source'
extract.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with tarfile.open(sdist) as archive:
    for member in archive.getmembers():
        path = Path(member.name)
        assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
        assert member.isfile() or member.isdir(), member.name
    archive.extractall(extract, filter='data')
source = next(p for p in extract.iterdir() if p.is_dir())
clean = ROOT/'public-clean-install'
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'venv', str(clean)], check=True)
env = dict(os.environ)
env.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
python = str(clean/'bin/python')
commands = [
    [python, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--no-deps', str(wheel)],
    [python, str(source/'scripts/check_standalone_install.py')],
]
logs = []
for command in commands:
    proc = subprocess.run(command, env=env, cwd=OUT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    logs.append({'command': command, 'returncode': proc.returncode, 'stdout': proc.stdout, 'stderr': proc.stderr})
    (ROOT/'public-install-log.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs, indent=2)+'\n')
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
receipt = {
    'verified': True,
    'authentication': 'anonymous public API and asset requests; no GitHub Authorization header',
    'release_url': release['html_url'], 'release_id': release['id'], 'tag': TAG,
    'source_commit': provenance['source_commit'], 'source_tree': provenance['source_tree'],
    'assets': checks, 'downloaded_wheel_clean_install': True,
    'downloaded_sdist_validation_script': True,
    'serving_evidence_relation': 'Public wheel is byte-identical to the previously tested wheel; no second serving series claimed.',
}
(ROOT/'public-readback.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))
